result.caveats: Mixed-source scene on 2023-08-08: active Kilauea vent and major Maui/Honolulu fires co-exist. SAM ocean-only segmentation creates 60+ km offsets from sources. Plume 1 may mix vog with Kona Hawaii Island fires; Mauna Loa flank cluster (n21, 17.2km from summit) may be lava not vegetation fire. Trade cumulus contaminates faint veil. ADP unavailable.
evidence: Scene shows two distinct regimes: broad diffuse gray haze SW of Hawaii Island near summits and long narrow gray streak WSW from central islands far from summits
Kilauea summit has 45 thermal pixels excluded as volcanic_thermal_excluded indicating active vent supporting vog
Plume 2 upwind only 22.0 km from large Kula Maui fire cluster n201 and >160 km from summits supporting wildfire smoke
